formulas.name: Schwarzschild length scale
formulas.caution: Defines the radial normalization; it does not itself assert a Schwarzschild metric.

formulas.name: Normalized radius
formulas.caution: Dimensionless coordinate used by the branch functions.

formulas.name: Golden ratio
formulas.caution: A declared SSZ model parameter in the strong branch, not an empirical fit result by itself.

formulas.name: Strong branch
formulas.caution: Canonical P0 strong branch.

formulas.name: Weak branch
formulas.caution: Matches GM/(rc²) because r_s=2GM/c².

formulas.name: Blend coordinate
formulas.caution: Maps the transition interval to [0,1].

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite bridge
formulas.caution: Six coefficients match value, slope and curvature at both endpoints.

formulas.name: C² endpoint conditions
formulas.caution: The derivatives are with respect to the same normalized coordinate.

formulas.name: Time factor
formulas.caution: Maps the segment field to the static clock factor.

formulas.name: Radial stretch
formulas.caution: Reciprocal scaling used in the diagonal ansatz.

formulas.name: Static spherical metric
formulas.caution: The angular radius is areal: sphere area is 4πr².

formulas.name: Unit-sphere line element
formulas.caution: Angular part of the metric.

formulas.name: Static proper time
formulas.caution: Not the proper time of a photon.

formulas.name: Radial null coordinate slope
formulas.caution: Coordinate slope, not locally measured light speed.

formulas.name: Static emitter-observer redshift
formulas.caution: Requires both radii; z=Ξ only for an observer at infinity.

formulas.name: Static redshift to infinity
formulas.caution: Does not include Doppler, plasma or transfer effects.

formulas.name: Horizon segment value
formulas.caution: Finite canonical P0 value.

formulas.name: Horizon clock factor
formulas.caution: Finite horizon factor; not proof of a regular centre.

formulas.name: Central coefficient limit
formulas.caution: Finite A does not imply finite curvature.

formulas.name: Ricci leading asymptotic
formulas.caution: Diverges at the areal centre.

formulas.name: Kretschmann leading asymptotic
formulas.caution: Coordinate-invariant curvature divergence.

formulas.name: Leading PPN light deflection
formulas.caution: With γ=1 this gives 2r_s/b; not a strong-field ray trace.

formulas.name: Leading Shapiro delay
formulas.caution: Geometry and one-way/two-way conventions must be stated.

formulas.name: Perihelion advance
formulas.caution: Compatibility here does not validate the interior.

formulas.name: Leading Sagnac difference
formulas.caution: A is loop area here, not the metric coefficient A(r).

formulas.name: Null circular-orbit diagnostic
formulas.caution: A maximum is a candidate circular null orbit; stability needs full analysis.

formulas.name: Stationary geodesic constant
formulas.caution: A conserved geodesic quantity, not automatically locally measured energy.

formulas.name: Azimuthal geodesic constant
formulas.caution: Used with normalization and radial equations.

formulas.name: Temporal metric coefficient
formulas.caution: A is not an independently fitted field.

formulas.name: Radial metric coefficient
formulas.caution: The identity A·B=1 is specific to this ansatz.

formulas.name: Inverse metric
formulas.caution: Coordinate components must not be interpreted as local measurements.

formulas.name: Metric determinant
formulas.caution: Its simple D cancellation does not establish central regularity.

formulas.name: Invariant coordinate-volume density
formulas.caution: A simple volume density does not imply finite curvature.

formulas.name: Static orthonormal coframe
formulas.caution: The static frame is an operational basis, not a freely falling frame.

formulas.name: Flow-form gamma field
formulas.caution: The repository calls this gamma; its physical interpretation must follow the declared coordinate construction.

formulas.name: Flow-form beta field
formulas.caution: This derived coordinate-flow parameter is not automatically a material velocity.

formulas.name: Non-diagonal flow metric
formulas.caution: A cross term does not by itself establish rotation or a global chart equivalence.

formulas.name: Flow-form radial null slopes
formulas.domain: radial null curve in flow chart
formulas.caution: These are coordinate slopes; local light speed remains c.

formulas.name: Proper radial length
formulas.caution: This is slice dependent and is not infall proper time.

formulas.name: Radial null travel time
formulas.domain: radial null curve in static chart
formulas.caution: A coordinate travel time, not a variable local light speed.

formulas.name: Strong-branch first derivative
formulas.caution: Derivative is with respect to normalized radius x.

formulas.name: Strong-branch second derivative
formulas.caution: Used in the left endpoint C² match.

formulas.name: Weak-branch first derivative
formulas.caution: Used in the right endpoint C² match.

formulas.name: Weak-branch second derivative
formulas.caution: Used in the right endpoint C² match.

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite left-value basis
formulas.caution: One of six endpoint-interpolation basis functions.

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite left-slope basis
formulas.caution: Multiplied by interval width and left slope.

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite left-curvature basis
formulas.caution: Multiplied by interval width squared and left curvature.

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite right-value basis
formulas.caution: One of six endpoint-interpolation basis functions.

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite right-slope basis
formulas.caution: Multiplied by interval width and right slope.

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite right-curvature basis
formulas.caution: Multiplied by interval width squared and right curvature.

formulas.name: Levi-Civita connection
formulas.caution: Connection components can be chart singular even when invariants are finite.

formulas.name: Riemann tensor
formulas.caution: Sign depends on the declared curvature convention.

formulas.name: Einstein tensor
formulas.caution: A geometric diagnostic here, not a derived SSZ equation of motion.

formulas.name: Effective stress tensor diagnostic
formulas.caution: Does not supply a fundamental SSZ matter action.

formulas.name: Geodesic equation
formulas.caution: Applies to free test trajectories in the effective geometry.

formulas.name: Timelike normalization
formulas.caution: Null trajectories instead have zero norm.

formulas.name: Null turning-point impact parameter
formulas.caution: A turning point is not automatically a circular orbit.

formulas.name: Circular null-orbit condition
formulas.caution: Stability follows from the second derivative and global accessibility.

formulas.name: Static clock-rate ratio
formulas.domain: static clocks compared in one stationary chart
formulas.caution: Transport and kinematic effects require a fuller protocol.

formulas.name: Weak-field potential correspondence
formulas.caution: Follows algebraically from r_s=2GM/c².

formulas.name: Weak-field time-factor expansion
formulas.caution: A local series; observable calculations still need the full metric.

formulas.name: Normalized residual
formulas.caution: Correlated measurements require a covariance matrix.

formulas.name: Correlated chi-square
formulas.caution: Model comparison must also address parameters, priors and selection effects.

formulas.name: Curvature dimensional check
formulas.caution: A required sanity check for central asymptotics.

formulas.name: Strong-branch central field limit
formulas.caution: This is a field limit, not proof that the centre belongs to a regular manifold.

formulas.name: Central clock-factor limit
formulas.caution: Finite D does not imply finite curvature.

formulas.name: Asymptotic flatness checkpoint
formulas.caution: An asymptotic limit does not determine the global interior.

formulas.name: Raw branch intersection
formulas.caution: The raw intersection is not one of the declared bridge endpoints.

formulas.name: Complete C² bridge
formulas.caution: Every derivative is taken with respect to the same normalized coordinate x.

formulas.name: Clock-factor derivative
formulas.caution: Derivative units depend on whether the independent variable is r or x.

formulas.name: Temporal coefficient derivative
formulas.caution: Used in circular-orbit diagnostics.

formulas.name: Radial coefficient derivative
formulas.caution: Large coordinate coefficients are not by themselves invariant singularities.

formulas.name: Static orthonormal time leg
formulas.caution: Defines a local frame only where a static observer is physically admissible.

formulas.name: Static orthonormal radial leg
formulas.caution: Separates local radial measurements from coordinate components.

formulas.name: Static-observer radial acceleration
formulas.domain: static diagonal ansatz and proper radial frame
formulas.caution: Sign and interpretation depend on derivative convention and observer choice.

formulas.name: Geodesic Lagrangian
formulas.caution: An effective test-particle Lagrangian is not the missing fundamental field action.

formulas.name: Timelike radial equation
formulas.domain: equatorial timelike geodesic; convention-dependent E and L
formulas.caution: Must be re-derived if the metric convention changes.

formulas.name: Null radial equation
formulas.caution: Turning points and circular orbits are different conditions.

formulas.name: Null-orbit stability diagnostic
formulas.caution: The sign convention must be matched to the chosen effective potential.

formulas.name: Circular-orbit coordinate frequency
formulas.domain: static spherical metric in areal radius
formulas.caution: Coordinate frequency requires conversion before comparison with a local clock.

formulas.name: Circular timelike angular momentum
formulas.caution: Denominator and normalization conventions must be checked.

formulas.name: Circular timelike energy
formulas.caution: Stability requires a separate second-derivative condition.

formulas.name: Marginal orbit stability
formulas.caution: Solving this condition is metric- and branch-specific.

formulas.name: Critical shadow impact parameter
formulas.caution: A shadow observable additionally needs source, inclination, transfer and rotation.

formulas.name: Two-radius frequency ratio
formulas.caution: Inverse placement of emitter and observer changes the reported z convention.

formulas.name: Special-relativistic line-of-sight Doppler factor
formulas.caution: This kinematic factor is separate from static gravitational scaling.

formulas.name: Combined schematic frequency map
formulas.caution: The transfer factor is model-dependent; this is a bookkeeping relation, not a universal closed formula.

formulas.name: PPN temporal metric expansion
formulas.caution: The sign of U must follow the declared PPN convention.

formulas.name: PPN spatial metric expansion
formulas.caution: A coordinate-gauge statement used for specific observable calculations.

formulas.name: Effective density projection
formulas.caution: Effective-source diagnostics are not fundamental SSZ matter content.

formulas.name: Weak energy condition
formulas.caution: A diagnostic condition; violations do not alone select or reject an effective geometry.

formulas.name: Dominant energy condition
formulas.caution: Requires a physically interpreted effective source.

formulas.name: Strong energy condition
formulas.caution: Its relevance depends on the underlying dynamical theory.

formulas.name: Two-sided paired sign-test probability
formulas.domain: independent exchangeable paired signs under the null
formulas.caution: Does not account for model flexibility, selection or correlated pairs.

formulas.name: Bootstrap percentile interval
formulas.caution: Bootstrap validity depends on sampling structure and independence assumptions.

formulas.name: Bayesian information criterion
formulas.caution: Lower BIC is an asymptotic model-selection heuristic, not proof.

formulas.name: Akaike information criterion
formulas.caution: Relative predictive criterion; absolute fit and data quality remain separate.

formulas.name: Stationary-spacetime Sagnac integral
formulas.caution: The leading 4AΩ/c² formula follows only in its controlled rotating-loop limit.
